verdict.rationale: Visa Intelligent Commerce is a payments platform/API (and its own MCP server offering, per visa-intelligent-commerce-docs-8/14/18), not an agent that itself consumes tools from user-supplied MCP servers. The story of 'plugging MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools' applies to AI agents, not to a payment-rails backend that other agents call — this is a category mismatch for this product type.
